description: This file contains unit tests for the EncounterDAO component of the openmrs-core project, specifically testing database interactions related to Encounter entities, such as retrieving saved encounter dates and querying encounters with different search parameters.

classes.name: EncounterDAOTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the EncounterDAO implementation within a context-sensitive environment, using Spring bean configurations.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes test data and retrieves the EncounterDAO from application context before each test.

methods.name: getSavedEncounterDatetime_shouldGetSavedEncounterDatetimeFromDatabase
methods.description: Tests that the DAO correctly retrieves the saved encounter datetime from the database, ensuring data consistency.

methods.name: getEncounters_shouldWork_WithNameQuery
methods.description: Verifies that querying encounters by a name returns the expected set of encounters.

methods.name: getEncounters_shouldWork_WithIdentifierQuery
methods.description: Verifies that querying encounters by numeric and string identifiers returns the expected encounters.

methods.name: initializeExpectedEncounters
methods.description: Helper method to initialize the list of expected encounters for the tests.

methods.name: getEncounters_shouldNotWork_WithPartialIdentifier
methods.description: Tests that querying encounters with a partial identifier returns no results, validating search precision.
